label: Describing the region
subgoals: Identify a region that is not type I

visual.title: A region with curved limits
visual.caption: The shaded cells are the ones whose centres lie between the two curves. The limits are functions of x, which is what makes this a type I region.

predict.question: The area between y = x² and y = x on [0, 1] is:
predict.explain: Subtract the lower curve: ∫₀¹ (x − x²) dx = 1/2 − 1/3 = 1/6. The grid approaches that value as it refines.
